subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should OpenClaw accept the one-way device-identity cutover in which Doctor retires `identity/device.json`, older JSON-only binaries cannot safely reuse the migrated state directory, and coordinated upgrades are required for shared state directories?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility and recovery policy, not a mechanical implementation choice; the PR body explicitly requests maintainer acceptance or deferral.

options.title: Accept after recovery fix
options.body: Fix the onboarding-reset regression, then accept the Doctor-owned SQLite-only cutover and document the aligned-upgrade requirement.

options.title: Defer the cutover
options.body: Keep the current JSON identity contract until maintainers choose a backward-compatible upgrade and downgrade path.

recommendation.title: Accept after recovery fix
recommendation.body: Fix the onboarding-reset regression, then accept the Doctor-owned SQLite-only cutover and document the aligned-upgrade requirement.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied stack history shows steipete carrying the proposed cross-runtime migration design and its follow-on native-state work.
